evidence_model: L5 claims are vectors, not a single pass/fail scalar

mcp-sdk-conformance.claim: official SDK client and server execute a Streamable HTTP tool call across separate OS processes, plus the SDK's modern HTTP request-classification behavior
mcp-sdk-conformance.claim_ceiling: Proves Python-to-Python loopback Streamable HTTP only; it does not prove cross-language interoperability, remote-network behavior, authorization, provider behavior, or production security.

a2a-sdk-conformance.claim: official SDK client discovers an AgentCard and streams a JSON-RPC task lifecycle from an official server in a separate OS process, plus explicit rejection of legacy top-level card fields
a2a-sdk-conformance.claim_ceiling: Proves Python-to-Python JSON-RPC over loopback only; it does not prove cross-language interoperability, HTTP+JSON/gRPC parity, remote authorization, task-store durability, or cancellation/subscription behavior.

openai-agents-runstate-restart.claim: official Agents SDK tool approval RunState is serialized, restored, approved or rejected, and resumed in a fresh OS process with exact call identity
openai-agents-runstate-restart.claim_ceiling: Uses the SDK's deterministic ScriptedModel and a local tool; it does not prove a hosted model/provider path or exactly-once delivery to an external API.

google-adk-session-restart.claim: official ADK DatabaseSessionService persists session state and Event trajectories across fresh OS processes with controlled approve/deny outcomes
google-adk-session-restart.claim_ceiling: Proves database-backed session and event durability only; it does not prove resumable instruction pointer, model-provider execution, or arbitrary tool exactly-once semantics.

langgraph-durable-restart.claim: official StateGraph and SQLite checkpointer resume approve/reject paths in fresh OS processes with replay and side-effect observations
langgraph-durable-restart.claim_ceiling: Does not prove distributed database failover, arbitrary graph migration, or exactly-once external effects; node-prefix replay requires application idempotency.

maf-checkpoint-restart.claim: official WorkflowBuilder and FileCheckpointStorage resume a canonical graph after a hard process boundary and reject a changed graph signature
maf-checkpoint-restart.claim_ceiling: Uses the core workflow package and local file storage on one host; it does not prove the meta-package integrations, distributed storage failover, graph migration, or exactly-once external APIs.
